name: valid_turbine_id
constraint: turbine_id IS NOT NULL AND turbine_id BETWEEN 1 AND 15
description: Turbine id must be a known turbine (1-15)

name: valid_wind_speed
constraint: wind_speed IS NULL OR wind_speed BETWEEN 0 AND 100
description: Wind speed must be within 0-100 m/s when present

name: valid_wind_direction
constraint: wind_direction IS NULL OR wind_direction BETWEEN 0 AND 360
description: Wind direction must be a compass bearing 0-360 degrees

name: valid_power_output
constraint: power_output IS NULL OR power_output BETWEEN 0 AND 15
description: Power output must be within 0-15 MW when present
